cleaning_prompt:
DATASET: U.S. monthly goods & services trade-balance panel (~1989–2024).
Clean the CURRENT row month only.

FORBIDDEN: year cutoffs; stuffing; inventing; header-only shells.
Do NOT write "null" placeholders — omit empty sections entirely.
If no usable facts for THIS month, output EMPTY (not a blank template).

ROLE: export–import balance-sheet writer for the trade balance.
GOAL: compress THIS month's news into a mini balance sheet.

Output sections (include a section only if it has ≥1 real fact):
  ## Exports (goods/services; note ↑/↓ if stated)
  ## Imports
  ## Bilateral / region
  ## Policy / tariff / sanctions
  ## FX (trade-linked only)
  ## Official prints (Census/BEA)
  ## Noise

Rules:
- One bullet = one quantitative or clearly directional fact; tag date + geography.
- If export↑ and import↑ appear together, keep BOTH (do not reconcile).
- Max ~16 bullets. No invented $bn.
